## ZGTA 5 — 1.1 beta 1 — AppSync
Experimental installation route; phone installation has not been verified.

**Requirements**
A compatible ARM64 rootful jailbreak on iOS 15.0–18.2, AppSync Unified 116.0+, appinst 2.1.1+, curl and coreutils. Not for RootHide or rootless. Your own matching prepared game files are required.

**Keep your existing app and data**
Use the TrollStore installer for a TrollStore-managed app. Do not install both installer variants or delete a working app to test AppSync. [Installation and compatibility guide](https://github.com/zemabinks/ZGTA-V/blob/main/docs/IOS-SIDELOADING.md).

### 1.1 beta 1
- Uses the ZGTA 5 name and 1.x product versioning; Sileo package version is `1.1~beta1`.
- Keeps the same Build 109 app and existing data.
- Includes iPhone/browser proximity voice, smooth volume changes with distance, separate microphone and nearby-voice controls. These features passed the owner’s paired test; this naming update does not add a new gameplay build.
- AppSync remains an experimental, untested installation route for compatible rootful devices.

Browser/Mac 1.2 is a separate release and does not change this iOS package.

[Earlier installer/build history](https://github.com/zemabinks/repo/blob/main/docs/zgta-v-changelog-archive.md#appsync)
